CustomField.description: Comma-separated list of HTTP status codes AIAgentManager treats as retryable - a callout returning one of these, with attempts remaining, comes back as retryable instead of failing the turn.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Example: 408,429,500,502,503,504,529. Leave blank to never retry. 400, 401, 403, 404, 410, 413 and 422 are never retried even if listed here: they fail the same way every time.
CustomField.label: Retryable Status Codes
